title: Every silent no-credit path of a host check reports its reason (host line, checkpoint card, durable per-host log)
outcome: Every silent no-credit path of a host check reports its reason (host line, checkpoint card, durable per-host log)
acceptance: Recognized test launches without a current work binding or active grant report the specific missing authority through the existing host notice, bounded run projection and durable observation/log owners, including Base enabled with turn-gated control disabled. An authorized checkpoint card may carry the diagnosis when one exists; the independent diagnosis does not require a checkpoint.

The diagnosis covers launcher full, launcher focused and recognized direct native tests. It belongs to the exact original command, runtime, turn and launch; later enablement or binding cannot relabel that launch as creditable. Completion without a correlated start reports unavailable provenance without inventing a start.

The change grants no work binding, grant, source basis, validated-unbound exemption or verification credit from registration, process exit or artifact PASS. Existing properly bound, granted and authoritatively checkpointed checks retain their real verification behavior; retained debt and dispatch exclusions are unchanged.

Diagnostic lifecycle handling remains bounded and deduplicated, preserves exact runtime/turn ownership across OFF/ON and generation changes, and reports capacity or tracking loss truthfully. Public text and retained logs expose no credentials or private report payloads; any persistence invariant change is classified before implementation.

Focused regression witnesses exercise missing binding and missing grant with Base ON/control OFF, all three recognized command families, OFF/ON and runtime/generation races, unmatched completion, deduplication and bounded tracking loss, plus the existing credited positive path. The exact-input required full gate and independent review pair pass before landing.
